title: How We Made IPFS Content Publishing 10x Faster
summary: ProbeLab team describes their optimization of IPFS content publishing through an 'optimistic provide' mechanism, achieving 10x performance improvement by reducing latency in content announcement across the network.
problem_solved: Slow content publishing and announcement process in IPFS that caused high latency when content providers announced data availability to the network.
why_valuable: This optimization significantly improves the user experience for IPFS content publishing and makes decentralized storage more practical for real-world applications.
